dedupe_keys.name: tud sumo research traffic simulation wrapper

description: TUD-SUMO is a Python wrapper developed by TU Delft DAIMoND Lab for research using the SUMO traffic simulator. It standardizes simulation control and data collection, and supplies traffic-signal logic, ramp metering, route guidance and variable-speed-limit controllers. A weather and event system introduces scheduled or dynamic incidents. Users provide a SUMO road network, traffic demand and control settings. Results can be saved, plotted or recorded as videos; the documentation identifies pickle as the default simulation-data format and supports floating-car position and speed output. Spatial coverage and simulation duration follow the selected network and experiment. Public code and documentation are free under Apache-2.0 and require Python 3.10 or later with SUMO-related dependencies. These functions support traffic-management and disruption experiments. A limitation is that calibrated networks and demand still have to be supplied, and controller results depend on the underlying simulation. Existing model-sumo is the required traffic engine. No simulation was run during this review.
